entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre Lesne was a French entomologist who specialized in the beetles, particularly the wood boring beetles of the family Bostrychidae. He also took an interest in parasitic Hymenoptera. The term "phoresy" was introduced by Lesne. He worked at the Museum of Natural History, Paris.
